ORDER from vc, 2026-10-26 07:23Z by date -u, on hv's word: Intent's nodes do all their light work now and nothing heavy. Intent's one full test cycle runs when molt-vc calls Intent's turn, and anything red is fixed forward.

LIGHT means edits, git, prettier, shellcheck, and one bats file you wrote, run alone. There is no cargo (build, check, test, clippy or doc), no swift or xcodebuild, and no devbin build.

THE BASE for every new bank is T: HEAD e0c15d474, then refs/bank/cc/0648/v5, refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04a-v2, refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04a-page-v3 and refs/bank/dc/0087-04/v2, applied in that order with `git apply --index` in a detached worktree (hooks off on the checkout). After that, `git write-tree` must print 05127fda654ca7ce4399081142e982344e5ac076. Bank `git diff --cached --binary 05127fda654ca7ce4399081142e982344e5ac076` as a blob on refs/bank/<node>/<unit>/<v>.

NEW BANKS CARRY NO CHANGELOG.md HUNK. Put the line's text in your READY, and vc writes every line in one commit at landing, because that section is the one file this stack would otherwise conflict in.

READY goes to vc with the ref, the blob, the patch-id, `git cat-file -p <ref> | git apply --stat`, the CHANGELOG line, and any judge leg your bank needs beyond the union. The union is: whole crate suites, fmt, both clippy legs, CI's doc command, the critic on each changed .rs and shell file, the generator check, tests/run_tests.sh and prettier.

vc verifies each bank against your worktree, stacks T + arms-v2 + 0652-cli + 0652-app + 0653, books ONE heavy with molt-vc, and runs the combined judge itself. A red goes back to the bank's author to fix forward. No push, no release.

cc: 0652's CLI half is yours (hv's split: cc builds the flag, ic the menu item). Build it over T.

THE CONTRACT, which ic's Copy URL calls and which ic writes into 0652's record as the shape: `intent estate status --url` prints exactly the URL `--browser` opens (estate_browse's served_url result, with the token and root in the fragment), followed by one newline, on stdout and nothing else, and exits 0. With no daemon answering, it refuses as `--browser` does: non-zero, with the refusal on stderr. It opens no browser.

The generated surface (surface/dispatch-table.* and docs/reference) needs a build to regenerate. Bank the hand-written code now. Regenerate the surface as the first step of Intent's turn, before the stacked judge, and re-bank then.

Your 0648 v5 and wp04a-v2 are in T as they stand and owe no re-bank. Yes, drop the spent ST0086/01 claim.
